integrity: The proof is mathematical and symbolic. The included high-precision numerical checker corroborates finite examples only. Novelty comparison includes complete readable primary sources but cannot establish absolute historical priority. No external independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats normalized Gaussian-window time-frequency localization on a single concentric phase-space annulus. All spectral switching formulas are valid for fixed positive annular area and arbitrary nonnegative inner-area parameter; the Bernoulli expansion holds for fixed area with the inner radius tending to infinity. No generalization to other windows, unions of annuli, or growing area is claimed. Known radial Hermite diagonalization and eigenvalue formulas are fully credited.
title: Exact Gaussian-annulus eigenmode crossings and a Bernoulli second-order concentration law
